Name: Traveling Spouse
Author: Changbaibai
Description:
[b][size=4]简介[/size][/b]
[size=3]让你通过电话为配偶预订一趟三天的旅行。TA会走出鹈鹕镇，去看看外面的世界，旅途中每天给你写信、寄照片、带特产回来。每个男性配偶都有多条基于其性格和兴趣的专属旅行线路。信件内容、照片和纪念品全部不同，每一趟旅行都是独立的小故事。[/size]

[b][size=4]流程[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]和电话互动，菜单中会多出一个"旅游服务热线"选项。[/*]
[*]支付旅行费用（可调，默认50,000金）为配偶预订三天旅行。[/*]
[*]第二天早上配偶出发，离家三天。[/*]
[*]每天你会在信箱里收到一封信：Day 1. 报平安的信件。 Day 2. 附带旅行照片的信件。 Day 3.附带当地特产纪念品的信件（可放置物品）。[/*]
[/list]
[b][size=4]当前支持的配偶与线路[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][b]哈维[/b] — 航空博览会 / 游轮之旅 / 花卉草药集市[/*]
[*][b]塞巴斯蒂安[/b] — 祖祖城观光 / 热带雨林[/*]
[*][b]谢恩[/b] — 环湖旅行 / 辣椒农场[/*]
[*][b]山姆[/b] — 摇滚演唱会 / 沙漠金字塔[/*]
[*][b]艾利欧特[/b] — 日照金山 / 海上列车[/*]
[*][b]通用线路[/b] — 3条通用线路，所有配偶可用，包括自定义角色[/*]
[/list]共计16条旅行线路，48封信件，16张照片，16件纪念品。

[b][size=4]前置要求[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]星露谷物语 1.6+[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.0+[/*]
[*]Generic Mod Config Menu（可选，用于游戏内设置）[/*]
[/list][b][size=4]安装方法[/size][/b]
[list=1]
[*]确保已安装SMAPI。[/*]
[*]下载本mod，将文件夹解压到 Stardew Valley/Mods/ 目录下。[/*]
[*]启动游戏即可。[/*]
[/list]若安装了GMCM，所有设置可在游戏内直接修改。否则编辑mod文件夹中的config.json。

[b][size=4]控制台指令[/size][/b]
打开SMAPI控制台窗口，可输入以下指令：

[code]
ts_status            — 显示当前旅行状态、信件状态和剩余可用线路。
ts_resettrips        — 重置当前配偶的已完成旅行记录，使所有线路重新可用。
ts_resettrips all    — 重置所有配偶的已完成旅行记录。
ts_endtrip           — 立即结束当前旅行并标记为已完成。[/code]
[b][size=4]常见问题[/size][/b]
[b]Q：旅行期间配偶会出现吗？[/b]
A：mod会在旅行期间从所有地点隐藏配偶。没有测试所有节日场景，如果发现配偶出现请反馈。

[b]Q：预订后可以取消旅行吗？[/b]
A：目前没有取消功能，旅行会完整进行三天。

[b]Q：旅行会重复吗？[/b]
A：不会。线路完成后不再出现，除非用指令重置。

[b]Q：支持自定义/mod配偶吗？[/b]
A：自定义配偶可以使用3条通用线路。专属线路目前仅支持原版男性配偶。

[b]Q：支持多人游戏吗？[/b]
A：仅支持单人模式。

[size=4][font=Arial Black][b]Introduction[/b][/font][/size]
Let you book a three-day trip for your spouse over the phone. They will leave Pelican Town to see the outside world, and during the trip they will write to you every day, send photos, and bring back local specialties. Each male spouse has multiple exclusive travel routes based on their personality and interests. The letter contents, photos, and souvenirs are all different, and each trip is an independent little story.

[size=4][font=Arial Black][b]How It Works[/b][/font][/size]
[list]
[*]Pick up the phone at home, and a new "Travel Service Hotline" option will appear in the menu.[/*]
[*]Pay the travel fee (adjustable, default 50,000g) to book a three-day trip for your spouse.[/*]
[*]The next morning your spouse departs and will be away for three days.[/*]
[*]Each day you will receive a letter in your mailbox: Day 1. A letter letting you know they are safe. Day 2. A letter with a travel photo. Day 3. A letter with a local specialty souvenir (placeable item).[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][font=Arial Black]Currently Supported Spouses and Routes[/font][/size]
[list]
[*]Harvey — Aviation Expo / Cruise Trip / Flower and Herb Market[/*]
[*]Sebastian — Zuzu City Sightseeing / Tropical Rainforest[/*]
[*]Shane — Lake Loop Trip / Chili Pepper Farm[/*]
[*]Sam — Rock Concert / Desert Pyramid[/*]
[*]Elliott — Sunrise Over Golden Mountains / Sea Train[/*]
[*]Generic Routes — 3 generic routes, available to all spouses, including custom characters[/*]
[/list]A total of 16 travel routes, 48 letters, 16 photos, and 16 souvenirs.

[size=4][font=Arial Black]Requirements[/font][/size]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.0+[/*]
[*]Generic Mod Config Menu (optional, for in-game settings)[/*]
[/list][size=4][font=Arial Black]Installation[/font][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Make sure SMAPI is installed.[/*]
[*]Download this mod and extract the folder into the Stardew Valley/Mods/ directory.[/*]
[*]Launch the game and you're ready to go.[/*]
[/list]If GMCM is installed, all settings can be changed directly in-game. Otherwise, edit config.json in the mod folder.

[size=4][font=Arial Black]Console Commands[/font][/size]
Open the SMAPI console window and enter the following commands:

[code]
ts_status            — Shows the current trip status, letter status, and remaining available routes.
ts_resettrips        — Resets the completed trip records for the current spouse, making all routes available again.
ts_resettrips all    — Resets the completed trip records for all spouses.
ts_endtrip          — Immediately ends the current trip and marks it as completed.[/code]
FAQ
Q: Will the spouse appear during the trip?
A: The mod hides the spouse from all locations during the trip. Not all festival scenes have been tested. If you find the spouse appearing, please report it.

Q: Can a trip be canceled after booking?
A: There is currently no cancellation feature. The trip will run for the full three days.

Q: Will trips repeat?
A: No. Once a route is completed, it will no longer appear unless reset with a command.

Q: Are custom/modded spouses supported?
A: Custom spouses can use the 3 generic routes. Exclusive routes currently only support the vanilla male spouses.

Q: Is multiplayer supported?
A: Single-player only.
